cohort: 2333 women admitted for delivery at Zagazig University Hospitals, Zagazig, Sharkia, Egypt, from January 2019 till June 2019.
finding: Robson Groups 5 (multiparous women with a previous cesarean section), 10 (singleton breech presentation at term, not in labor), and 2 (multiparous women with a single cephalic presentation at term, in spontaneous labor) were the main contributors to the overall cesarean section rate.
